title: Multipoint Padé Approximation of the Hurwitz Zeta Function and a Riemann-Hilbert Steepest Descent Analysis
summary: We study multipoint Padé approximants of type $(n,n)$ for the Hurwitz zeta function $f(a)=ζ(s,a)$ with $\Re s>1$, constructed at quantile nodes $a_{n,j}=nα_{n,j}$ generated by a real-analytic density $κ$ on $[A,B]\Subset(0,\infty)$. Under the determinantal nondegeneracy condition $\mathrm{(ND)}_n$ for large $n$ and in the regular one-cut soft-edge regime of the associated constrained equilibrium problem, we formulate the approximation as a matrix Riemann--Hilbert problem with poles and carry out a Deift--Zhou nonlinear steepest descent analysis.
